mapper.sql: FROM adapay_member member LEFT JOIN adapay_corp_member corp ON member.id = corp.member_id
mapper.select:
SELECT member.id AS id, member.company_id AS company_id, member.location AS location, member.user_name AS user_name, member.member_type AS member_type, member.operator_type AS operator_type, corp.legal_person AS legal_person
ORDER BY member.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
